subject: Problem in create function with dlply

messages.author: 7edfe2ae4a1e4b1d
messages.subject: Problem in create function with dlply
parts:
Hi all:

I want to create my function with dlply(), but I can't do it well
after try several times. Below is a demo of my code, I hope to find a
correct way to transfer variable into dlply()

it works well in this way:

<code>dlply(iris,"Species",summarize,mean(Sepal.Length))</code>


But when I want to create my own function to get the same result, I
encounter some problems shown below
<code>
myfun <- function(x)
{
dlply(iris,"Species",summarize,mean(x))
}
myfun("Sepal.Length")
</code>

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: Problem in create function with dlply
parts:
If you want to summarise a user selected variable, I'd recommend not
using the summarise helper function:

dlply(iris,"Species", function(df) mean(df[[x]]))

Hadley
